sentences.zh: 当我读这些信时，我开始理解

sentences.en: the power of the psychological tools Don used to hook men like Jesse.
sentences.zh: 唐用来勾住杰西这样的男人的心理工具的力量。

sentences.en: Most of the letters aren't epic
sentences.zh: 大多数信件都不是史诗般的

sentences.en: fantasies.
sentences.zh: 幻想。

sentences.zh: 大多数都是关于帕梅拉生活的琐事。

sentences.en: She goes to the bank.
sentences.zh: 她去银行。

sentences.en: She talks to co-workers.
sentences.zh: 她和同事说话。

sentences.en: She tells Jesse her thoughts on televangelists.
sentences.zh: 她向杰西讲述她对电视布道者的看法。

sentences.en: Over and over, Pamela tells Jesse how much he means to
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉一次又一次地告诉杰西，他对她来说是多么

sentences.en: her.
sentences.zh: 重要。

sentences.en: She praises him, encourages him.
sentences.zh: 她赞美他，鼓励他。

sentences.en: When you read the letters one after the other, like Jesse did day
sentences.zh: 当你像杰西那样日复一日、年复一年地

sentences.en: after day after day, it paints a picture that feels real.
sentences.zh: 连续阅读这些信件时，它描绘出了一幅感觉真实的画面。

sentences.en: I felt that Pamela and the letters was a real
sentences.zh: 我觉得帕梅拉和这些信件是一个真实存在的

sentences.en: person, and I knew Don was writing them.
sentences.zh: 人，而我知道是唐写了它们。

sentences.en: There were other tricks.
sentences.zh: 还有其他的把戏。

sentences.en: In one letter, Pamela asked Jesse to
sentences.zh: 在一封信中，帕梅拉要求杰西

sentences.zh: 在读信时把她的一张照片放在手边，这样他就会觉得她和他在同一个房间里。

sentences.en: Jesse put up
sentences.zh: 杰西把她的

sentences.en: two photos of her on the wall.
sentences.zh: 两张照片贴在墙上。

sentences.en: She once sent him a dime.
sentences.zh: 她曾给他寄过一枚十分硬币。

sentences.zh: 在那封信里，她告诉杰西她刚刚

sentences.en: had a strange day.
sentences.zh: 度过了奇怪的一天。

sentences.en: Another driver bashed her car but didn't leave a note.
sentences.zh: 另一个司机撞了她的车却没留便条。

sentences.en: Just when it looked like the
sentences.zh: 正当看起来糟糕的日子

sentences.en: day couldn't get any worse, she lost her purse.
sentences.zh: 不能再坏的时候，她丢了钱包。

sentences.en: Depressed, Pamela spotted this very dime on the
sentences.zh: 沮丧的帕梅拉在街上发现了

sentences.en: street.
sentences.zh: 这枚硬币。

sentences.en: She picked it up, hoping it was a lucky charm.
sentences.zh: 她把它捡起来，希望它是个幸运符。

sentences.en: Later, a little boy showed up with her purse.
sentences.zh: 后来，一个小男孩送回了她的钱包。

sentences.en: A woman called and took responsibility for the car.
sentences.zh: 一个女人打电话来为汽车事故承担责任。

sentences.en: Pamela told Jesse she was giving him her lucky dime.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉告诉杰西，她要把她幸运的十分硬币送给他。

sentences.en: Here's Jesse reading from the end of that letter.
sentences.zh: 这是杰西在朗读那封信的结尾。

sentences.en: Keep this dime, darling.
sentences.zh: “留着这枚硬币吧，亲爱的。

sentences.en: Let us always remind you
sentences.zh: 愿它时刻提醒你，

sentences.en: that good people can still come into your life, and good things can still happen to you, and also
sentences.zh: 善良的人依然会走进你的生活，美好的事依然会降临在你身上，并且

sentences.en: think of this as a small token of my affection for you.
sentences.zh: 把它当作我对你的一点爱意表达。

sentences.en: If you hold it in your hand and squeeze it hard,
sentences.zh: 如果你把它握在手里，用力捏紧，

sentences.en: you'll feel the warmth of my love coming out of it.
sentences.zh: 你就会感受到从它散发出的我的爱的温暖。”

sentences.en: Did you actually do that, Jesse?
sentences.zh: 你真的那样做了吗，杰西？

sentences.en: Yes, I think I did
sentences.zh: 是的，我想我在每件事上

sentences.en: do that in everything.
sentences.zh: 都确实那样做了。

sentences.en: Like I said, Jesse's mother had recently died, and his dad had heart trouble.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，杰西的母亲最近去世了，他父亲心脏不好。

sentences.en: He spent a lot of time looking after him.
sentences.zh: 他花了很多时间照顾他。

sentences.en: He wrote letters to Pamela, confiding in her about his
sentences.zh: 他给帕梅拉写信，向她倾诉他

sentences.en: depression.
sentences.zh: 的抑郁。

sentences.en: She sent him heartfelt letters about bad relationships she'd had, and she told him about
sentences.zh: 她给他寄来发自内心的信，讲述她曾经历的糟糕恋情，还告诉他

sentences.en: visiting her grandfather, who was suffering from dementia.
sentences.zh: 去探望患有痴呆症的祖父。

sentences.en: That really took its toll on her, so I kind
sentences.zh: 那对她真的是个很大的折磨，所以我有点

sentences.en: of bonded with that knowing that she was going through the same thing that I was.
sentences.zh: 与此产生共鸣，因为我知道她经历的事情和我一样。

sentences.en: Me and her kind of more or less
sentences.zh: 我和她之间的那种情感纽带，可以说是超越了我

sentences.en: bonded more than any other person I've ever talked to.
sentences.zh: 聊过的任何其他人。

sentences.en: It was kind of like a beacon from outside.
sentences.zh: 这有点像来自外界的灯塔。

sentences.en: It was like if you
sentences.zh: 这就像如果你

sentences.en: were a ship out at sea, and you were looking for a lighthouse, which they used that in the deal to look for the light
sentences.zh: 是一艘在大海航行的船，你在寻找一座灯塔——他们在交易中确实用过寻找灯光之类的比喻——

sentences.en: and everything, and guide yourself towards it, where you know that you'll have safe haven.
sentences.zh: 并指引自己朝它驶去，在那里你知道自己会拥有安全的避风港。

sentences.en: I'm not sure I'm exactly following you.
sentences.zh: 我不太确定我是否完全理解你的意思。

sentences.en: Is this something from one of the letters where they basically talk about the lighthouse?
sentences.zh: 这是信件里的内容吗，他们基本上是在谈论灯塔？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In fact, I got a little wooden figure of a lighthouse that she sent to me at one time and everything.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我有她曾经寄给我的一个小小木质灯塔摆件之类的东西。

sentences.en: I said, let this beacon know that somebody's out there looking out for you and everything.
sentences.zh: 我说，让这座灯塔知道外面有人在照顾你之类的。

sentences.en: If Jesse had wanted to see it, there were plenty of signs the letters were mass-produced.
sentences.zh: 如果杰西想要发现的话，有大量的迹象表明这些信件是批量生产的。

sentences.en: They look typed, but the paper doesn't have the indentations that come from typewriter keys.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来像打印的，但纸上没有打字机按键留下的压痕。

sentences.en: The signatures look like they've been stamped or printed.
sentences.zh: 签名看起来像是盖章或印上去的。

sentences.en: All the specifics in the letters are about Pamela's life.
sentences.zh: 信中的所有具体细节都是关于帕梅拉的生活。

sentences.en: In the letters, did Pamela ever ask you how you were handling your mom's death?
sentences.zh: 在信中，帕梅拉有没有问过你是如何应对母亲去世的？

sentences.en: Not that I remember.
sentences.zh: 我不记得了。

sentences.en: No, I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 没有，我想没有。

sentences.en: Did she ask how your dad's health was?
sentences.zh: 她问过你父亲的健康状况吗？

sentences.en: Not that I remember at this time, no.
sentences.zh: 目前我记不起来了，没有。

sentences.en: In fact, when I read Pamela's letters to Jesse, she never mentions any of the things he's told her.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我读帕梅拉写给杰西的信时，她从未提及他告诉过她的任何事情。

sentences.en: When Pamela talks about Jesse's life, she switches into generalities.
sentences.zh: 当帕梅拉谈到杰西的生活时，她会切换到泛泛而谈。

sentences.en: I know you're sad.
sentences.zh: 我知道你很难过。

sentences.en: I know you're lonely.
sentences.zh: 我知道你很孤独。

sentences.en: I know you're having a hard time.
sentences.zh: 我知道你正经历艰难时光。

sentences.en: The only way the letters are personalized is that Jesse's name is sprinkled throughout,
sentences.zh: 这些信件唯一个性化的地方在于，杰西的名字被点缀在各处，

sentences.en: autofilled, like a Madlip sheet.
sentences.zh: 像填字游戏一样自动填充。

sentences.en: To Jesse, it didn't matter.
sentences.zh: 对杰西来说，这并不重要。

sentences.en: He saw what he wanted to see.
sentences.zh: 他看到了他想看到的东西。

sentences.en: At the time, I wasn't really fully absorbing all of that.
sentences.zh: 当时，我并没有真正完全消化这一切。

sentences.en: I had a lot more on my plate, kind of in turmoil with everything that was going on.
sentences.zh: 我手头有更多的事要处理，随着发生的一切，生活有点陷入混乱。

sentences.en: So I just read him and I kind of took some encouragement out of it.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是读信，并从中获得了一些鼓励。

sentences.en: Did you ever have doubts about what was going on as you were receiving the letters?
sentences.zh: 在你收到信件的时候，你有没有对正在发生的事情产生过怀疑？

sentences.en: Well, no, not at the time and everything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没有，当时没有之类的。

sentences.en: Like I said, I was glad to be getting letters from somebody,
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，我很高兴能收到某人的来信，

sentences.en: and even though you're paying money for that because you have blinders on
sentences.zh: 尽管你为此付了钱，因为你戴着眼罩，

sentences.en: and not really paying attention to all of that.
sentences.zh: 并没有真正关注这一切。

sentences.en: Like I said, when you're not the best-looking person in the world,
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，当你不是世界上长得最好看的人时，

sentences.en: that somebody out of the blue that write to you and tell you things
sentences.zh: 会有人突然写信给你，对你说些话，

sentences.en: and kind of build up your spirits and everything and stuff
sentences.zh: 并振奋你的精神之类的，

sentences.en: because everybody looks at you and stuff.
sentences.zh: 因为每个人都在打量你之类的。

sentences.en: It's kind of like the deal with a hunchback of Notre Dame.
sentences.zh: 这有点像《巴黎圣母院》里那个驼子的遭遇。

sentences.en: You'll never find anybody that will care for you.
sentences.zh: 你永远不会找到任何会在乎你的人。

sentences.en: But there at the end, he wound up making a friend
sentences.zh: 但在最后，他最终和那些

sentences.en: with the people that befriended him and everything.
sentences.zh: 对友好待他的人成为了朋友之类的。

sentences.en: At a certain point, Pamela became the thing that kept Jesse afloat
sentences.zh: 在某个特定时刻，帕梅拉成了支撑杰西度过难关的精神支柱——

sentences.en: when he had to work long hours,
sentences.zh: 当他必须长时间工作时，

sentences.en: when he had to close his restaurant and rush his father to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 当他不得不关掉餐馆并紧急送父亲去医院时。

sentences.en: Yes, there was one thing that really kindly touched me and everything.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一件事真的深深触动了我之类的。

sentences.en: I was telling her I'm ready to give up and everything.
sentences.zh: 我当时告诉她我已经准备放弃了之类的。

sentences.en: And she just told me, get back on your feet and everything.
sentences.zh: 她只是告诉我要重新振作起来之类的。

sentences.en: So that really was the word of encouragement and everything.
sentences.zh: 所以那真的是一句充满鼓励的话之类的。

sentences.en: As Don went on, he realized his members were hooked
sentences.zh: 随着唐的继续，他意识到他的会员们已经上钩了，

sentences.en: and he could take the fantasy further, much further.
sentences.zh: 他可以把幻想推得更远，远得多。

sentences.en: He invented an epic world for his angels
sentences.zh: 他为他的天使们虚构了一个史诗般的世界，

sentences.en: with a magical backstory and a fantastic future.
sentences.zh: 有着神奇的背景故事和奇妙的未来。

sentences.en: Here's how it worked.
sentences.zh: 它是这样运作的。

sentences.en: The angels supposedly lived together in a retreat,
sentences.zh: 据说天使们一起住在隐蔽的静修所里，

sentences.en: hidden away from the world.
sentences.zh: 远离尘世。

sentences.en: Most were lost souls, escaping drugs and bad men.
sentences.zh: 大多数都是迷失的灵魂，逃避毒品和坏男人。

sentences.en: These were women who needed a steady hand and a strong shoulder.
sentences.zh: 这些都是需要稳妥的照顾和强有力的依靠的女性。

sentences.en: As he invented more angels, Don came up with interweaving backstories.
sentences.zh: 随着他虚构出更多的天使，唐想出了相互交织的背景故事。

sentences.en: Some angels were good, some bad.
sentences.zh: 有些天使是好的，有些是坏的。

sentences.en: Angels helped one another, backstabbed each other.
sentences.zh: 天使们互相帮助，也互相背叛。

sentences.en: All the men who signed up to join the Lonely Hearts Club
sentences.zh: 所有报名加入寂寞心俱乐部的人

sentences.en: understood they were joining an organization of good-hearted men
sentences.zh: 他们以为自己加入的是一个由善良男士组成的组织

sentences.en: who were devoted to taking care of the angels.
sentences.zh: 他们致力于照顾那些天使。

sentences.en: The organization was known as The Call.
sentences.zh: 这个组织被称为“召唤”。

sentences.en: Don promised members of The Call that they would one day move with the angels
sentences.zh: 唐向“召唤”的成员承诺，他们总有一天会和天使们一起搬到

sentences.en: to a valley paradise, into a giant building shaped like a naked woman lying down on the grass.
sentences.zh: 一个山谷中的人间天堂，住进一座造型犹如裸女躺在草地上的巨型建筑里。

sentences.en: This lady-shaped building would house meeting rooms and auditoriuMs.
sentences.zh: 这座女性形状的建筑里设有会议室和礼堂。

sentences.en: The paradise was to be called Shondaza.
sentences.zh: 这个人间天堂将被命名为肖恩达扎。

sentences.en: In exchange for their contributions,
sentences.zh: 作为对他们捐款的回报，

sentences.en: the members would have their needs looked after at Shondaza.
sentences.zh: 成员们在肖恩达扎的需求将会得到照顾。

sentences.en: All their needs.
sentences.zh: 他们所有的需求。

sentences.en: At the center of the entire fantasy was a matriarch,
sentences.zh: 整个幻想的中心是一位女家长，

sentences.en: a saintly woman named Mother Maria.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫玛丽亚妈妈的圣洁女人。

sentences.en: Maria collected and managed the money from the members,
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚负责收集和管理成员们的资金，

sentences.en: and she organized and disciplined the angels.
sentences.zh: 她还负责组织和管教天使们。

sentences.en: She was said to have mystical powers and could re-virginize fallen women.
sentences.zh: 据说她拥有神秘的力量，能够让堕落的女性重归贞洁。

sentences.en: There were photos of Mother Maria.
sentences.zh: 当时有玛丽亚妈妈的照片。

sentences.en: She was beautiful.
sentences.zh: 她长得很美。

sentences.en: Maria's photos were actually of a woman named Esther.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚的照片其实是一个名叫埃丝特的女人。

sentences.en: She was Don's wife.
sentences.zh: 她是唐的妻子。

sentences.en: Not all the members of The Call believed in Shondaza.
sentences.zh: 并非“召唤”的所有成员都相信肖恩达扎的存在。

sentences.en: Jesse stuffed the letters describing Shondaza in the back pocket of the binder.
sentences.zh: 杰西把描述肖恩达扎的信件塞进了活页夹的后袋里。

sentences.en: He figured it was just some wacky idea Pamela had, and just ignored it.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这只是帕梅拉的一些古怪想法，便没去理会。

sentences.en: But there were other fish who found this hook tempting.
sentences.zh: 但还有其他鱼儿觉得这个鱼钩很有诱惑力。

sentences.en: In my mind, you know, I always held this area of,
sentences.zh: 在我心里，你知道的，我总是保留着这样一个领域，

sentences.en: tried not to be convinced, you know, 100% about it, you know.
sentences.zh: 努力克制自己，你知道的，不要对它百分之百确信，你知道的。

sentences.en: Surely, you know, it's too good to be true.
sentences.zh: 当然了，你知道的，这好得让人难以置信。

sentences.en: This is Ken Blanchard.
sentences.zh: 这位是肯·布兰查德。

sentences.en: He's a big, gentle man and was another member of The Call for many years.
sentences.zh: 他是个身材魁梧、性格温和的男士，也是“召唤”多年的另一位老成员。

sentences.en: He was single when he joined, and he was still single when I met him in 2012.
sentences.zh: 他加入时还是单身，2012年我见到他时他依然单身。

sentences.en: What was the draw?
sentences.zh: 吸引力在哪里呢？

sentences.en: What did you tell yourself when you said, you know, this is too good to be true?
sentences.zh: 当你对自己说“这好得令人难以置信”的时候，你是怎么安慰自己的？

sentences.en: Well, I think with me, it was the prospect of maybe at least having some sort of communication
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得对我来说，那是一种展望，至少觉得能和某些人取得某种交流，

sentences.en: with some women, you know, maybe my age, maybe, you know,
sentences.zh: 也许是跟我差不多大的人，也许，你知道的，

sentences.en: maybe a little bit too young for me, maybe, you know, even then.
sentences.zh: 也许对我来说稍微年轻了一点，也许，你知道的，哪怕在当时也是如此。

sentences.en: But it sounded like kind of a neat idea, you know, to, you know, be kind of on the leading edge
sentences.zh: 但听起来倒是个不错的主意，你知道的，去，你知道的，有点像走在前沿

sentences.en: or something like that, you know.
sentences.zh: 或者诸如此类的事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: Oh, geez, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，我不知道。

sentences.en: Well, like I say, I don't know what else to try to explain my part of it
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像我说的，我不知道还能怎么解释我这部分的心路历程

sentences.en: or, you know, belief in it or anything.
sentences.zh: 或者说，你知道的，对它的信仰之类的事情。

sentences.en: They got me hooked, you know, on what they were saying and everything, and I believed them.
sentences.zh: 他们让我着迷了，你知道的，因为他们说的话以及种种，而且我都相信了。

sentences.en: Don got hundreds of new sign-ups every year.
sentences.zh: 唐每年都能吸引数百名新会员注册。

sentences.en: Millions of dollars flowed back to Don's headquarters in Moline, Illinois.
sentences.zh: 数百万美元源源不断地流向唐位于伊利诺伊州莫林的总部。

sentences.en: He bought himself expensive cars, a Rolls-Royce, and a Mercedes.
sentences.zh: 他给自己买了好车，一辆劳斯莱斯，还有一辆奔驰。

sentences.en: He bought his sons and Esther everything they wanted.
sentences.zh: 他给他的儿子们和埃丝特买下了他们想要的一切。

sentences.en: He got a big office in downtown Moline and operated a print shop.
sentences.zh: 他在莫林市中心租下了一间大办公室，经营着一家印刷厂。

sentences.en: He hired assistants, salespeople, and ghostwriters to expand his operation.
sentences.zh: 他雇用了助理、销售人员和枪手来扩大他的业务。

sentences.en: By the mid-1980s, Don was writing love letters to more than 30,000 men.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪80年代中期，唐一直在给3万多名男性写情书。

sentences.en: We had lawyers, doctors, professors, mechanics, bakers, you name it.
sentences.zh: 我们的成员有律师、医生、教授、机械师、面包师，应有尽有。

sentences.en: All kinds of people were members.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的人都是我们的会员。

sentences.en: We even had a priest join the call.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至还有一个牧师加入了召唤组织。

sentences.en: Really.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: Wait, that's not a Catholic prieSt.
sentences.zh: 等等，那不是天主教牧师。

sentences.en: Yeah, a Catholic prieSt.
sentences.zh: 对，是个天主教牧师。

sentences.en: What was he hoping to get out of it?
sentences.zh: 他指望从中得到什么呢？

sentences.en: Who the hell knows?
sentences.zh: 鬼才知道呢！

sentences.en: It was probably just bored.
sentences.zh: 他大概只是觉得无聊吧。

sentences.en: To exploit this growing market, Don constantly experimented with new schemes and products.
sentences.zh: 为了开发这个不断增长的市场，唐不断尝试新的计划和产品。

sentences.en: He started selling cassette tapes where the angels flirted with the men.
sentences.zh: 他开始出售磁带，磁带里的天使们跟男人们调情。

sentences.en: He got into merch.
sentences.zh: 他开始涉足周边商品。

sentences.en: Mugs, puzzles, commemorative coins, all with angels' faces printed on them.
sentences.zh: 马克杯、拼图、纪念币，上面都印着天使的面孔。

sentences.en: And we sent out a pillowcase with Angel Terry's face on it.
sentences.zh: 我们还寄出了印有特里天使面孔的枕套。

sentences.en: And I can sleep with Angel Terry every night.
sentences.zh: 这样我每天晚上都能和特里天使一起睡觉了。

sentences.en: Oh, we know a lot of things like that.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们知道很多这样的事情。

sentences.en: The members weren't just sending in cash and checks.
sentences.zh: 会员们寄来的不仅仅是现金和支票。

sentences.en: They were sending gifts.
sentences.zh: 他们还寄来了礼物。

sentences.en: Ken sent Angel Vanessa a windbreaker.
sentences.zh: 肯给瓦妮莎天使寄了一件风衣。

sentences.en: Others sent coats and shoes.
sentences.zh: 其他人则寄来了大衣和鞋子。

sentences.en: Even gardening equipment so the angels could grow vegetables at their secret retreat.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有园艺工具，好让天使们能在她们的秘密隐居处种菜。

sentences.en: Did you encourage them to send personal items?
sentences.zh: 你鼓励他们寄个人物品吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I hated that.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌那样。

sentences.en: Here's a guy.
sentences.zh: 比如说有这么一个人。

sentences.en: His wife died.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子去世了。

sentences.en: And she left all kinds of jewelry and dresses and so on.
sentences.zh: 她留下了各种各样的珠宝、连衣裙等等。

sentences.en: Put them in a big cardboard box and mail it to us.
sentences.zh: 把它们装进一个大纸箱里寄给我们。

sentences.en: What the hell are we going to do with it, huh?
sentences.zh: 我们拿这玩意儿到底能干什么，啊？

sentences.en: Now, what you wanted, of course, was you wanted them to send a check.
sentences.zh: 当然了，你真正想要的是让他们寄支票过来。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 对，当然。

sentences.en: Or a money order or a cash or anything.
sentences.zh: 或者是汇票、现金，什么都行。

sentences.en: Did you tell them not to do it?
sentences.zh: 你告诉过他们不要这么做吗？

sentences.en: Very subtly.
sentences.zh: 非常委婉地说过。

sentences.en: I didn't want to hurt their feelings.
sentences.zh: 我不想伤害他们的感情。

sentences.en: They thought they were doing a great thing for the angels by saying these clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们以为通过寄这些衣服，是在为天使们做一件伟大的事。

sentences.en: Yeah, I didn't want to hurt them.
sentences.zh: 对，我不想伤害他们。

sentences.en: My dad would blazingly just, he would have sidewalk sales.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸总是大张旗鼓地，他会在人行道上搞促销特卖。

sentences.en: Lingerie and gifts and jewelry.
sentences.zh: 内衣、礼品和珠宝。

sentences.en: This is Don's son, Rico Lowry.
sentences.zh: 这是唐的儿子里科·洛瑞。

sentences.en: And my dad would blazingly just, he'd be selling the lingerie on racks in front of the print shop.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸总是大张旗鼓地，他会在印刷厂门前的架子上售卖那些内衣。

sentences.en: He would actually put up racks on the sidewalk in front of the print shop?
sentences.zh: 他竟然真的把货架摆在印刷厂门前的人行道上？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: My dad had a very sarcastic and wicked sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 我父亲有一种非常讽刺且恶劣的幽默感。

sentences.en: A local police officer told me men from all over the country started showing up in Moline,
sentences.zh: 当地的一位警官告诉我，全国各地的男士开始涌向莫林，

sentences.en: asking where they could find the angels.
sentences.zh: 打听去哪里能找到天使们。

sentences.en: If they found their way to the print shop, Don called the cops on them.
sentences.zh: 如果他们找到了印刷厂，唐就会报警把他们抓起来。

sentences.en: Dumbfounded police tried to explain to the men that there was no Angel Vanessa,
sentences.zh: 目瞪口呆的警察试图向这些男士解释，根本没有什么瓦妮莎天使，

sentences.en: no Retreat, no Shondaza.
sentences.zh: 没有什么隐居处，也没有什么肖恩达扎。

sentences.en: But occasionally, if Don was in the mood,
sentences.zh: 但有时，如果唐心情好，

sentences.en: he'd actually allow them to meet female employees whom he had asked to pose as angels in photos.
sentences.zh: 他甚至会允许他们见见那些女性员工——他曾让这些员工在照片里假扮天使。

sentences.en: In time, Don even set up events for his most loyal members to meet the angels.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，唐甚至为他最忠实的会员举办了与天使会面的活动。

sentences.en: He called them gatherings.
sentences.zh: 他把这些活动叫做聚会。

sentences.en: At the gathering in Chicago, an advice columnist offered dating suggestions.
sentences.zh: 在芝加哥的聚会上，一位情感专栏作家提出了约会建议。

sentences.en: A comedian told jokes.
sentences.zh: 一位喜剧演员讲了笑话。

sentences.en: Angels in yellow-green dresses leapt around on stage in an interpretive dance.
sentences.zh: 穿着黄绿色长裙的天使们在舞台上跳着现代舞四处蹦跳。

sentences.en: Jesse went to the Moline gathering.
sentences.zh: 杰西去了莫林的聚会。

sentences.en: He was excited to finally meet Pamela.
sentences.zh: 他很高兴终于见到帕梅拉了。

sentences.en: She looked just like she did in her pictures.
sentences.zh: 她长得跟照片里一模一样。

sentences.en: In fact, she was one of Don's employees.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她就是唐的一名员工。

sentences.en: And her name really was Pamela.
sentences.zh: 而且她的名字确实叫帕梅拉。

sentences.en: She greeted Jesse warmly.
sentences.zh: 她热情地迎接了杰西。

sentences.en: But Jesse's excitement was tempered by the fact that there were a dozen other men at the gathering.
sentences.zh: 但聚会上还有其他十几个男人，这让杰西的兴奋之情大打折扣。

sentences.en: Jesse was shocked to find that every man thought he was in a personal relationship with Pamela, too.
sentences.zh: 杰西震惊地发现，每个男人都以为自己也和帕梅拉有着私密恋情。

sentences.en: They crowded around her, vying for her attention.
sentences.zh: 他们簇拥在她周围，争夺着她的注意力。

sentences.en: And then that's when it dawned on me and I said, hey, this is not what I thought it would be or anything.
sentences.zh: 然后就在那时我恍然大悟，我说，嘿，这可不是我想象的那样或者别的什么。

sentences.en: That it was a rip-off.
sentences.zh: 这是一个骗局。

sentences.en: Well, that was kind of like getting a kick in the stomach.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那感觉就像是在肚子上挨了一脚。

sentences.en: It was upsetting and everything.
sentences.zh: 让人心烦意乱，诸如此类。

sentences.en: We send all that money in this and that and the other.
sentences.zh: 我们把所有的钱都投进这啊那啊的里面。

sentences.en: And it wasn't what it was meant to be.
sentences.zh: 而事情根本不是它原本该有的样子。

sentences.en: It got you down to reality and stuff.
sentences.zh: 这让你认清了现实，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Jesse knew that Pamela lacked music boxes, so he bought her an expensive one with a tiny record on it that played When the Saints Go Marching In.
sentences.zh: 杰西知道帕梅拉缺音乐盒，于是他给她买了一个昂贵的音乐盒，上面有一个播放《圣徒行进曲》的小唱片。

sentences.en: Pamela loved it.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉很喜欢。

sentences.en: He said she stared at it and let the record play.
sentences.zh: 他说她盯着它看，任由唱片播放着。

sentences.en: It went on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 音乐一遍又一遍地播放着。

sentences.en: The other men stood around them and looked at Jesse.
sentences.zh: 其他男人站在他们周围，看着杰西。

sentences.en: They looked at Pamela, then back to Jesse.
sentences.zh: 他们看着帕梅拉，然后又看向杰西。

sentences.en: He liked that he was making them jealous.
sentences.zh: 他很享受自己让他们嫉妒的感觉。

sentences.en: Jesse didn't blame Pamela.
sentences.zh: 杰西并没有怪帕梅拉。

sentences.en: He wasn't exactly sure how the scam worked, but he was sure that the woman standing before him was the same woman who wrote to him.
sentences.zh: 他虽然不太清楚这个骗局是怎么运作的，但他确信眼前这个女人就是给他写信的那个女人。

sentences.en: That she was the one who had read his letters.
sentences.zh: 她就是那个读过他信件的人。

sentences.en: The proof?
sentences.zh: 证据呢？

sentences.en: Pamela's dog jumped into his lap.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉的狗跳到了他的大腿上。

sentences.en: She jumped on my lap twice and everything.
sentences.zh: 她跳到我的腿上跳了两次，诸如此类。

sentences.en: That really surprised Pamela.
sentences.zh: 这让帕梅拉大吃一惊。

sentences.en: So I guess she smelled my scent on the letters I was writing to her and everything and stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以我想她是从我写给她的信里闻到了我的气味，等等之类的。

sentences.en: We got in touch with Pamela to see if she remembered any of this,
sentences.zh: 我们联系了帕梅拉，看她是否还记得这些事，

sentences.en: but she declined to be interviewed on tape for the story.
sentences.zh: 但她拒绝就这个故事接受录音采访。

sentences.en: She did confirm that she hadn't written the letters.
sentences.zh: 她确实证实了那些信不是她写的。

sentences.en: Jesse made friends with a couple of other men at the meeting,
sentences.zh: 杰西在聚会上和另外几个男人交了朋友，

sentences.en: particularly two guys named Lenny and Al.
sentences.zh: 尤其是两个名叫伦尼和阿尔的家伙。

sentences.en: They were all like strangers who had independently watched the same soap opera for many years.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是一群互不相识的人，却各自独立地看了一部多年的肥皂剧。

sentences.en: Well, we got to talking about it and say,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们开始讨论这事，然后说，

sentences.en: well, why did you write on to this and everything?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你为什么会写信给这个之类的？

sentences.en: Instead of bonding with the girls,
sentences.zh: 我们没有去和姑娘们套近乎，

sentences.en: we ended up talking to each other
sentences.zh: 反倒成了我们彼此聊天

sentences.en: and meeting your friends and talking about the troubles we had.
sentences.zh: 并结识朋友，倾诉我们遇到的烦恼。

sentences.en: So we kind of,
sentences.zh: 所以我们有点像，

sentences.en: well, they were just like me and everything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们和我是一类人，诸如此类。

sentences.en: So we stayed in correspondence.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直保持着书信往来。

sentences.en: Like they said,
sentences.zh: 就像他们所说的那样，

sentences.en: they wrote me letters
sentences.zh: 他们给我写信，

sentences.en: and they even called me at my restaurant
sentences.zh: 甚至还打到我的餐馆来

sentences.en: to ask me how things were going and everything
sentences.zh: 问我近况怎么样之类的，

sentences.en: and finding out,
sentences.zh: 了解情况，

sentences.en: asking about my dad and everything.
sentences.zh: 打听我父亲的情况等等。

sentences.en: So that kind of was encouraging
sentences.zh: 所以这某种程度上挺让人感到鼓舞的

sentences.en: to hear somebody calling to want to check on you and everything.
sentences.zh: 听到有人打电话来关心你什么的。

sentences.en: In other words,
sentences.zh: 换句话说，

sentences.en: they asked about all the personal stuff Pamela never asked about.
sentences.zh: 他们询问了所有帕梅拉从未过问的私事。

sentences.en: Lenny and Al stayed in touch until they died.
sentences.zh: 伦尼和阿尔一直保持联系，直到去世。

sentences.en: What finally brought Don Lowry's cam to an end
sentences.zh: 最终终结唐·洛里骗局的

sentences.en: was a woman named Susan Rasso.
sentences.zh: 是一个名叫苏珊·拉索的女人。

sentences.en: She was a model that Don had worked with.
sentences.zh: 她曾是唐合作过的一名模特。

sentences.en: She had gotten into a car crash and called Don for help.
sentences.zh: 她遭遇了一场车祸，并打电话向唐求助。

sentences.en: He showed up at the hospital with a photographer.
sentences.zh: 他带着一名摄影师出现在医院。

sentences.en: They unbandaged her wounds and took pictures.
sentences.zh: 他们解开她伤口上的绷带并拍了照片。

sentences.en: They sent these to all the men who were corresponding with Angel Susan
sentences.zh: 他们把这些寄给所有与天使苏珊通信的男士

sentences.en: and asked them for help in paying her medical bills.
sentences.zh: 并请求他们资助支付她的医疗费用。

sentences.en: But Don didn't give Susan the money.
sentences.zh: 但唐并没有把钱给苏珊。

sentences.en: She went to the cops.
sentences.zh: 她报警了。

sentences.en: And she came to our office.
sentences.zh: 她也来到了我们的办公室。

sentences.en: She revealed the promises Mr. Lowry had made to her and broken.
sentences.zh: 她揭露了洛里先生曾向她做出却又违背的承诺。

sentences.en: The return that Mr. Lowry received was staggering
sentences.zh: 洛里先生得到的回报是惊人的

sentences.en: in terms of dollars and cents.
sentences.zh: 在金钱方面。

sentences.en: This is Lieutenant Kenneth Rexroth of the Moline Police Department.
sentences.zh: 这是莫林警察局的肯尼斯·雷克斯罗斯中尉。

sentences.en: He'd been aware of Don Lowry for years.
sentences.zh: 他多年来一直知道唐·洛里的存在。

sentences.en: He turned away many men who'd come to the police station
sentences.zh: 他打发走了许多来到警察局的男士

sentences.en: in search of the Angels.
sentences.zh: 寻找那些天使们。

sentences.en: And he'd been looking for a way to lock Don up.
sentences.zh: 他一直在寻找把唐关起来的方法。

sentences.en: He was very diabolical.
sentences.zh: 他非常恶毒。

sentences.en: He's a sinister person.
sentences.zh: 他是个阴险的人。

sentences.en: I consider Mr. Lowry to be an evil man.
sentences.zh: 我认为洛里先生是个邪恶的人。

sentences.en: But thanks to Susan Rasso,
sentences.zh: 但多亏了苏珊·拉索，

sentences.en: the police finally had evidence to obtain subpoenas.
sentences.zh: 警方终于有了获取传票的证据。

sentences.en: They raided Don's print shop.
sentences.zh: 他们突击搜查了唐的印刷厂。

sentences.en: They found out that some men sold everything
sentences.zh: 他们发现有些男士卖掉了一切

sentences.en: in order to give their life savings to the Angels.
sentences.zh: 只为了把他们毕生的积蓄交给天使们。

sentences.en: One man lived out of his car and forwarded his social security check to his Angel.
sentences.zh: 有个男人住在车里，把自己的社保支票转发给他的天使。

sentences.en: When the police got in touch with these guys,
sentences.zh: 当警方与这些家伙取得联系时，

sentences.en: many of them realized for the first time
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人第一次意识到

sentences.en: that their treasured letters were written by a man.
sentences.zh: 他们珍视的信件竟然是一个男人写的。

sentences.en: What I was turned out to be angry about
sentences.zh: 我最终感到生气

sentences.en: and more embarrassed about more than anything
sentences.zh: 而且比什么都感到尴尬的是

sentences.en: was the fact that he was even involved.
sentences.zh: 竟然连他也参与其中的事实。

sentences.en: Any man at all was even involved.
sentences.zh: 任何男人居然都参与其中。

sentences.en: Again, this is Ken Blanchard,
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这是肯·布兰查德，

sentences.en: who spent years receiving letters from Angel Vanessa.
sentences.zh: 他花了多年时间接收来自天使凡妮莎的信件。

sentences.en: When I found out that these letters I'd been getting all these times
sentences.zh: 当我发现这些我一直收到的信件

sentences.en: and I thought it was some girl sharing something with me,
sentences.zh: 而我以为是有哪个女孩在跟我分享心事时，

sentences.en: well, then I found out it was him writing the darn thing.
sentences.zh: 好吧，然后我发现居然是这家伙在写这些鬼东西。

sentences.en: I thought, my God, what the hell am I getting into?
sentences.zh: 我想，天哪，我到底卷入了什么鬼地方？

sentences.en: But I can laugh about it now,
sentences.zh: 但我现在可以对此一笑了之，

sentences.en: but I think at the time I did have some feelings about that
sentences.zh: 但我想当时我对这件事确实有些看法

sentences.en: that weren't very charitable.
sentences.zh: 并不是那么宽容。

sentences.en: Don's lawyer said that if members believed the Angels were real,
sentences.zh: 唐的律师说，如果成员们相信天使是真实的，

sentences.en: that was on them.
sentences.zh: 那是他们自己的事。

sentences.en: As Don told me many years later,
sentences.zh: 正如唐多年后对我说的那样，

sentences.en: People believe what they want to believe.
sentences.zh: 人们只相信他们愿意相信的。

sentences.en: You cannot dissuade them.
sentences.zh: 你无法劝阻他们。

sentences.en: Most members believe the Angels lived forever
sentences.zh: 大多数成员相信天使们永远活着

sentences.en: and a never, never land called to retreat.
sentences.zh: 在一个叫做静修所的世外桃源里。

sentences.en: We told them they lived forever.
sentences.zh: 我们告诉他们，他们长生不老。

sentences.en: They never grew old.
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会变老。

sentences.en: Does that tell you anything?
sentences.zh: 这说明了什么吗？

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 啊？

sentences.en: Well, you're surprised that they believed you?
sentences.zh: 怎么，你很惊讶他们竟然相信了你？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And it helped them.
sentences.zh: 而且这帮助了他们。

sentences.en: I mean, it made them happy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这让他们感到快乐。

sentences.en: So, big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以，这有什么大不了的。

sentences.en: Don and Pamela were charged with mail fraud, conspiracy, and money laundering.
sentences.zh: 唐和帕梅拉被控邮件欺诈、共谋和洗钱。

sentences.en: The press mobbed the trial.
sentences.zh: 记者们蜂拥至审判现场。

sentences.en: Don was shamed in the press, called a snake oil salesman at People magazine.
sentences.zh: 唐在媒体前名誉扫地，《人物》杂志称他为贩卖神油的江湖郎中。

sentences.en: Which brings me back to what got me interested in the story in the first place,
sentences.zh: 这就让我回到了最初让我对这个故事感兴趣的原因，

sentences.en: the thing that really surprised me.
sentences.zh: 真正让我感到惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: Many members flew from all over the country to show up at the courthouse in defense of the call.
sentences.zh: 许多成员从全国各地飞来，出现在法院外为召唤辩护。

sentences.en: Some stood outside with picket signs defending the Brotherhood.
sentences.zh: 一些人拿着抗议标语站在外面为兄弟会辩护。

sentences.en: Jesse and his friend Al were both there.
sentences.zh: 杰西和他的朋友阿尔都在场。

sentences.en: As they waited outside the courtroom, Jesse saw Pamela come up.
sentences.zh: 当他们在法庭外等候时，杰西看到帕梅拉走了过来。

sentences.en: He rushed over to her.
sentences.zh: 他冲了过去。

sentences.en: She was walking up, and I noticed she was cold, so I took off my jacket and draped it over her shoulders,
sentences.zh: 她走过来时，我注意到她很冷，所以我脱下夹克披在她的肩膀上，

sentences.en: and we walked all the way up to the courthouse.
sentences.zh: 我们就这样一直走到法院。

sentences.en: I was kind of like a security guard.
sentences.zh: 我当时就像个保镖一样。

sentences.en: And after she went indoors, I took my coat off, and I backed off and everything.
sentences.zh: 等她进屋后，我脱下外套，退到了一边。

sentences.en: Did she say anything to you at that point?
sentences.zh: 那时候她对你说了什么吗？

sentences.en: No, not really.
sentences.zh: 不，并没有。

sentences.en: Members testified on the stand and said the call had been a critical, beautiful part of their lives.
sentences.zh: 成员们在证人席上作证说，这个召唤是他们生命中至关重要、无比美好的部分。

sentences.en: One man said letters from the angel saved him from alcoholism and thoughts of suicide.
sentences.zh: 有个男人说天使的来信拯救了他，让他摆脱了酒精中毒和自杀的念头。

sentences.en: Jesse testified, too.
sentences.zh: 杰西也作证了。

sentences.en: This is him reading a court transcript of what he said on the stand.
sentences.zh: 这是他在宣读他在证人席上所说之话的法庭记录。

sentences.en: Well, it gave you, like I said, inspiration to continue,
sentences.zh: 嗯，它给了你，就像我说的，继续下去的灵感，

sentences.en: no matter what the circumstances that you were going through,
sentences.zh: 无论你当时正经历着什么样的环境，

sentences.en: that if you persevered, you could make it.
sentences.zh: 只要你坚持不懈，你就一定能挺过去。

sentences.en: Do you remember saying this at the trial?
sentences.zh: 你还记得在审判时说过这些话吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我记得。

sentences.en: Would you say that you still stand by what you said at trial?
sentences.zh: 你会说你仍然坚持你在审判时说过的话吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So here's the thing, Jesse.
sentences.zh: 所以问题是这样的，杰西。

sentences.en: You know, Don Lowry lied to you and sent you letters on behalf of someone else for many years,
sentences.zh: 你知道，唐·洛里多年来一直对你撒谎，并代表其他人给你写信，

sentences.en: and you formed an emotional connection with this woman who was writing to you.
sentences.zh: 而你与这个给你写信的女人建立了一种情感联系。

sentences.en: When, at the same time, you showed up at trial to essentially defend Don Lowry,
sentences.zh: 然而与此同时，你出现在审判现场，基本上是为了辩护唐·洛里，

sentences.en: and I'm trying to understand how and why you did that.
sentences.zh: 而我正试图理解你当时是怎么想的，为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: Well, like I said before, it wasn't actually defending him,
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像我之前说的，其实不是在为他辩护，

sentences.en: but it was actually Pamela that was the one that we were all,
sentences.zh: 但实际上帕梅拉才是我们所有人……

sentences.en: we turned our attention to help her,
sentences.zh: 我们将注意力转移到帮助她，

sentences.en: and that meant helping Don also and everything.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着顺便也帮助了唐之类的。

sentences.en: I understand that Don was really the mastermind of the operation,
sentences.zh: 我明白唐实际上是整个行动的主谋，

sentences.en: but when she showed up at these meetings,
sentences.zh: 但当她出现在这些会议上时，

sentences.en: and she presented herself as the same Pamela who was the Pamela in the letters,
sentences.zh: 她表现得自己就是信中那个帕梅拉本人，

sentences.en: wasn't she lying to you?
sentences.zh: 她难道不是在对你撒谎吗？

sentences.en: Well, I guess you could think about that that way, yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想你可以这么认为，是的。

sentences.en: Did you ever think about it that way?
sentences.zh: 你以前从这么想过吗？

sentences.en: No, not until now and everything,
sentences.zh: 不，直到现在这一切被重新翻出来之前都没有。

sentences.en: when all of this has been re-brought out and everything.
sentences.zh: 直到这一切又被重新提起。

sentences.en: Don and Pamela were both found guilty.
sentences.zh: 唐和帕梅拉都被判定有罪。

sentences.en: Pamela served two years in prison.
sentences.zh: 帕梅拉在监狱服刑两年。

sentences.en: Don was in prison for ten years.
sentences.zh: 唐入狱十年。

sentences.en: When I met Don, I asked him whether he felt he did anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 当我见到唐时，我问他是否觉得自己做错了什么。

sentences.en: I think I did something very wrong.
sentences.zh: 我想我确实做了一件非常错误的事。

sentences.en: I suppose I made it a little bit too real.
sentences.zh: 我想我把它弄得太真实了一点。

sentences.en: You know, I did.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我确实这么做了。

sentences.en: I made it too real.
sentences.zh: 我把它弄得太真实了。

sentences.en: Jesse lives alone now with his dog Chewbacca.
sentences.zh: 杰西现在和他的狗楚巴卡独自生活。

sentences.en: He's in his 60s and is still single.
sentences.zh: 他已经六十多岁了，至今仍然单身。

sentences.en: He's had some complications from diabetes recently
sentences.zh: 他最近有一些糖尿病引发的并发症，

sentences.en: and had parts of his foot amputated.
sentences.zh: 部分脚部被截肢了。

sentences.en: It hasn't been easy.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易。

sentences.en: My producer, Stephanie Fu, visited him at his house in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我的制作人斯蒂芬妮·傅去他在德克萨斯州的家中看望了他。

sentences.en: I was in the hospital after my amputation,
sentences.zh: 我在截肢手术后住在医院里，

sentences.en: running around on my knee scooter,
sentences.zh: 用膝行车到处跑，

sentences.en: said, you can still do this, keep going and everything.
sentences.zh: 她说，你还能做到这一点，继续前进什么的。

sentences.en: So I remember those words she told me,
sentences.zh: 所以我记得她对我说过的那些话，

sentences.en: get on your feet, so I do that and everything and keep going.
sentences.zh: 站起来，所以我照做了，然后继续前行。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Even now, even today.
sentences.zh: 即使现在，直到今天。

sentences.en: Even today and everything and stuff.
sentences.zh: 直到今天依然如此。

sentences.en: So, but basically that line, you know, get on your feet,
sentences.zh: 所以，但基本上就是那句话，你知道，站起来，

sentences.en: it doesn't really matter who wrote it.
sentences.zh: 是谁写的其实并不重要。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You think back, but it brings back fond memories of way back when
sentences.zh: 你回想起来，但这会唤起对往昔的美好回忆，

sentences.en: and you could be in your hundreds and everything or older
sentences.zh: 哪怕你活到百岁或者更大，

sentences.en: and I hope to have this on my mind on down the line and everything and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我希望以后心里还能一直记着这些。

sentences.en: Jesse still has the little wooden lighthouse Pamela sent him.
sentences.zh: 杰西还留着帕梅拉送给他的那个小木制灯塔。

sentences.en: It's on his dresser in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 它摆在他卧室的梳妆台上。

sentences.en: And he still has two photos of Pamela in his den,
sentences.zh: 他的书房里还放着两张帕梅拉的照片，

sentences.en: one on the wall, one on his desk.
sentences.zh: 一张挂在墙上，一张放在书桌上。

sentences.en: In one, she's sitting in an office chair,
sentences.zh: 其中一张里，她坐在一张办公椅上，

sentences.en: hands in her lap,
sentences.zh: 双手放在膝头，

sentences.en: not glamorous or sexy or anything.
sentences.zh: 既不光鲜亮丽，也不性感迷人。

sentences.en: Jesse says,
sentences.zh: 杰西说，

sentences.en: she's just sitting there, being herself.
sentences.zh: 她就坐在那里，做她自己。

sentences.en: It's just a little something to say.
sentences.zh: 这只是随口说的一点心意。

sentences.en: I made a friend.
sentences.zh: 我交到了一个朋友。
